sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values
sources.licence: project contribution under the repository's terms

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added with the nightshades work (2026-10-17): every character from the floras in the nightshades notes (plantgen-claude project-files/nightshades/SOURCES.md), drawn by the rules its taxa hold; drawing values only where no character says them.

taxon.note: WCVP v16 accepted name Nicotiana tabacum, plant_name_id 2382275 (Library 1.0 list, read 2026-10-17).

growth_form.note: Its habit as the floras describe it, drawn by the forb form.

growth.note: Grown to the age it is drawn at: an annual's one season, a perennial's or shrub's few years.

variants.note: One seed in the open, as the built-in species.

generator.params.note: Drawing values no character gives (nightshades, 2026-10-17): one plant from one seed; a thick stem (Wikipedia) 24 mm at the foot; eighteen leaves, the largest low on the stem and the upper much smaller, by eye from photographs (iNaturalist 319612673).

allometry.note: King's American Dispensatory (1898 text, 1905 printing), vol. 2, Tabacum, p. 1907 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): stem 4-6 ft; Wikipedia 'Nicotiana tabacum': 1-3 m. Its reference height is the middle of that range, 1.5 m, at its last keyframe.

traits.life_span.note: King's American Dispensatory (1898 text, 1905 printing), vol. 2, Tabacum, p. 1907 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): an annual herb.

traits.height_typical_m.note: King's American Dispensatory (1898 text, 1905 printing), vol. 2, Tabacum, p. 1907 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): stem 4-6 ft; Wikipedia 'Nicotiana tabacum': 1-3 m.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of British India vol. 4 (Clarke, 1883-85), Nicotiana Tabacum, p. 245 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): leaves large, oblong or elliptic; King's: ovate or lanceolate, acuminate.

traits.leaf_apex.note: King's American Dispensatory (1898 text, 1905 printing), vol. 2, Tabacum, p. 1907 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): acuminate.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 4 (1914-17), Nicotiana (genus account), p. 2143 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): leaves entire or wavy.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: King's American Dispensatory (1898 text, 1905 printing), vol. 2, Tabacum, p. 1908 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): 1 or 2 ft long, 6 or 8 in broad; Wikipedia: can be over 50 cm.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: King's American Dispensatory (1898 text, 1905 printing), vol. 2, Tabacum, p. 1908 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): 6 or 8 in broad.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: King's American Dispensatory (1898 text, 1905 printing), vol. 2, Tabacum, p. 1907 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): leaves sessile, decurrent; Bailey: half-clasping, somewhat auricled.

traits.leaf_colour.note: King's American Dispensatory (1898 text, 1905 printing), vol. 2, Tabacum, p. 1907 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): viscid and pale green. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: panicle 10-30 cm.

traits.corolla_shape.note: King's American Dispensatory (1898 text, 1905 printing), vol. 2, Tabacum, p. 1907 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): corolla funnel-shaped, widening toward the top, with a spreading limb; Flora of British India: linear-funnel-shaped.

traits.flower_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: flower 1-1.5 cm across; Wikipedia gives the tube 7-12 mm wide at its top.

traits.corolla_tube_length_m.note: Wikipedia, 'Nicotiana tabacum' (read 2026-10-17): corolla tube 3.5-4.5 cm in all, 3-5 mm wide below and 7-12 mm above; Bailey (vol. 4 p. 2144): corolla 2-3 times the calyx.

traits.bark_colour.note: iNaturalist observation 319612673 (CC-licensed photograph, viewed 2026-10-17): the thick stem is pale green, as are the leaves. No text read gives it.

traits.flower_colour.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 4 (1914-17), Nicotiana Tabacum, p. 2144 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): limb rose-coloured or red; King's: dull red. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.petal_apex.note: King's American Dispensatory (1898 text, 1905 printing), vol. 2, Tabacum, p. 1907 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): 5 acute lobes; Bailey: acute or acuminate.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Wikipedia, 'Nicotiana tabacum' (read 2026-10-17): capsule 1.5-2 cm long, narrowly elliptic to egg-shaped.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: ripe capsule brown.

traits.corolla_tube_colour.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 4 (1914-17), Nicotiana Tabacum, p. 2144 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): corolla with a white or whitish tube and a rose or red limb; Wikipedia 'Nicotiana tabacum': tube greenish cream, pink or red. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.flowering_months.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: in flower from July to September: Britton and Brown (vol. 3, c. p. 171) give June to September for the field tobacco of the same genus, Nicotiana rustica, an annual grown the same way; N. tabacum is set out later, after frost, and topped as its flowers open (Wikipedia 'Tobacco').

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: capsules ripening from August into October, after the July to September flowers.
